note: Norton County KS (20137) parcels are not published as a queryable ArcGIS/WFS/OGC service or bulk file. The state ORKA portal for Norton shows only a terms-acceptance disclaimer with no service links; ORKA parcel data requires a per-county request approved by the county, with possible fees. KS_ORKA_Extras has no Norton parcel polygon layer. The county website links only to ORKA. Other parcel sources found are commercial vendors (Regrid, Rockford Map, Equator Studios, acres.com).
